# SPD-012 — Backups, WAL checkpointing and .gitignore for .spud/

## Brief
The database is not in git. Per the spike's Topology ([[SPD-006]]): `spud backup` runs `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` then `VACUUM INTO .spud/backups/ledger-<stamp>.db`; a native scheduled task runs it daily, and `spud migrate` runs it before every migration; retention of 14 daily copies; `.spud/` in `.gitignore`. The committed rendered markdown stays the disaster-recovery import source.

Depends on [[SPD-007]], which ships the `backup` command; this ticket is the schedule, the retention and the ignore rules.

Done when: a scheduled run leaves a dated copy under `.spud/backups/`, the fifteenth day prunes the oldest, and `git status` never shows `.spud/`.

At cutover (2026-09-12, on Eric's go) Spud added `.spud/` and `__pycache__/` to `.gitignore` (commit ef953e5), so this ticket keeps backups and WAL checkpointing only.

Scheduler (Eric, 2026-09-13, when he started the ticket): a macOS LaunchAgent, not a Claude scheduled task. A scheduled task would start a fresh Claude session in this repo every day (Fable pinned in `.claude/settings.json`, Spud's CLAUDE.md and hooks loaded, usage spent, and only while the app is open); the LaunchAgent runs the CLI alone, with the app closed, and catches up after sleep. `spud backup` already checkpoints the WAL and runs before every migration (SPD-007). What remains: the daily run with its retention, a way to see the copies (`spud doctor`, since the hooks refuse shell commands naming `.spud/`), and the agent's install and removal. Spud installs the agent after Eric merges the branch.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, no children. **Tier: the persona's own, not the sonnet override proposed at filing.** Reason: retention deletes files beside the live database, which is expensive if wrong, and the doctor report and tests follow the CLI's conventions. No Fable on any member, child or probe (Eric, 2026-09-13). Installing the daily schedule is Spud's, after Eric merges the branch and with his yes.
